Their background is exclusively in web, mobile, and embedded software development with no evidence of hardware-software co-design, GPU architecture, or AI accelerator work.
strengths: Extensive full-stack software engineering experience across multiple languages and domains
Strong open-source contributions and community engagement (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Demonstrated ability to build and optimize high-performance systems (e.g., low-latency DLang apps)
concerns: No experience with SoC, IP modeling, or AI accelerator hardware design
No evidence of deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture expertise
